test.selected_source_prompt:
Create ONE master native 3x3 contact sheet from the supplied synthetic flower-shop reference. Strictly retain the same adult woman, face, short bob, white blouse, green apron, bouquet, shelves and warm lighting; introduce no new characters or props. Nine consecutive moments, with realistic DoF changes. Put each exact safe-margin label beside its own panel; labels must not cover subject. Panels:
KF1 | ELS | 1.6s: wide establishing shot, same adult woman standing in flower shop holding bouquet
KF2 | LS | 1.6s: full-body view, same white blouse green apron, same bouquet, same shelves
KF3 | MS | 1.6s: medium shot, a breeze gently stirs leaves beside the bouquet
KF4 | CU | 1.6s: close-up, same woman's eyes noticing the moving leaves
KF5 | MCU | 1.6s: medium close-up, same woman slowly rotating bouquet in her hands
KF6 | ECU | 1.6s: extreme close-up, fingertips lightly brushing pink rose petals
KF7 | OTS | 1.6s: over-shoulder, bouquet tilted toward soft window light
KF8 | Low | 1.6s: low angle, same woman lifting bouquet slightly with a soft smile
KF9 | ELS | 1.6s: wide closing shot, same woman relaxed among unchanged flower displays
